mentions.name: Gymify
mentions.description: This web app helps people seamlessly integrate exercise into daily life through short 1-2 minute exercise sessions spread throughout the day. It provides pressure-free tracking of exercise, discovery of new exercises, and social accountability by letting users see what other people do and don't do in terms of exercise.
mentions.problem: Exercise is typically rigidly scheduled and compartmentalized rather than woven into daily life.
mentions.audience: People who want to integrate exercise into their daily life and stay in shape
mentions.source_excerpt: https://gymify.it to seamlessly integrate exercise into daily life, rather than rigidly scheduling and compartmentalizing it. Small exercise sessions of 1-2 minutes throughout the day clear my head, give me fresh ideas, and keep me in shape. I'm building this site as a tool to keep track in a pressure-free way and to discover new exercises. It's partly about social accountability and one of the key ideas is to see what people do and don't do in terms of exercise.
